create.name: Reverend Bodhi Be
create.bio:
Reverend Bodhi Be works with death as a spiritual teacher and practical guide on Maui. With his wife Leilah Be and Ram Dass he founded Doorway Into Light, a nonprofit that since 2006 has offered education and volunteer support around conscious ageing, dying and death, and that since 2012 has also run Hawaii's only nonprofit, certified green funeral home, in Haiku. He sees an honest awareness of death as one of the quickest ways to change how we live, and treats looking after people at the end of life, and their bodies afterwards, as sacred service rather than business.

His teaching centres on the role of the death doula, which he describes as someone who keeps a place for death in community life. He has run international death doula trainings on Maui and online courses on preparing for one's own dying, and leads a six-month certification for doulas he has trained, with live sessions twice a month and guest teachers. His conversations on dying with Ram Dass and with the writer Alan Clements are shared as videos, and the Clements conversation became the book Facing Death.

books.title: Facing Death: A Conversation with Reverend Bodhi Be
books.author: Alan Clements and Reverend Bodhi Be
books.description: A book-length conversation between the writer Alan Clements and Bodhi Be about dying, after-death care and living with the knowledge of death. It grew out of their recorded talks at Doorway Into Light.

courses.title: Death Doula Certification (2027)
courses.description: A six-month online certification for people who have completed a Doorway Into Light death doula training. Two live Zoom sessions a month cover a topic with a guest teacher and reflection on participants' bedside experience.
